about: BN5's mood and its DarkChip rule in BN6's battles (the Souls track's S7): KnightSoul held, a deck of Cannon * with BN5's DarkCirc R (BN6's registry id 214) twenty-first. The Cannon fired from the top row misses (no gain); CanGard's shots lower his mood a hit at a time (BN5's loss, 10 a hit) from the opening's 0x80 to 0x3A, worried (under 0x41). The second Custom screen's worried rule (BN5 0x08025118) deals DarkCirc into the hand's end (slot 4) where the first screen's compaction had shelved it; each game's cursor starts on the DarkChip (the first hand chip whose record +9 has 0x20: BN6 0x0802806C, BN5 0x08023EC4), A picks it, OK, A uses it: dark for the battle, his mood 0 to the battle's end (DarkCirc deletes CanGard at t1504 in both, the fight's last frame t1537). Compared frame by frame to t1501 (compare_to): the chip's own attack is the chips track's DarkChip work (BN6's registry DarkCirc runs its twin's family, not BN5's) and BN5's per-DarkChip effect on his NaviStats (0x0802C938: DarkCirc's +0x54 += 100) not ported; the mood is held to the end by the expectations, in both battles.
subject: megaman
expect_why: BN5's battle: each CanGard hit lowers the mood by its collision's loss (0x08012818: 10, never under 1); worried at 0x40 and under (the emotion getter 0x08012738: 1); the worried rule at the screen's opening, before the compaction (0x08022CFC calls 0x08025118, then 0x080250EA), swaps the deck's BN5 DarkChip into the hand's end; DarkCirc used (0x08010028-0x08010080) sets the mood 0 (0x0801007C), which no writer moves again (set, gain and loss all leave 0). BN6's engine keeps the same mood in the Souls' block (src/emu/soulmood.c: its hit hook at 0x0801A24C, the rule and the shelf at the compaction 0x0802945A, the chip's use at 0x080127C0), its own NaviStats +0x0E set 0 with it (dark: no Cross, no Beast Out), BN6_SOUL_DARK the latch.
